baseline.basis: quoted read-only from the PPR-027 machinery's own defaults (experiments/ppr-027/compose.ts: maxRetryAttempts 1, retry-once-next-supply, retryCooldownMs 5; experiments/ppr-027/driver.ts: pollIntervalMs 10)

totalIncludingDuplicates.basis: synthetic-price-schedule:transport-charges-per-physical-dispatch (nano-USD summed over every attempt of every execution, rounded once to integer micro-USD)

duplicates.basis: synthetic-price-schedule:transport-charges-per-duplicate-attempt (every attempt beyond the first of each execution — the duplicate-attempt truth)

verification.basis: synthetic-price-schedule:no-verification-charge (internal verification draws no provider charge under the declared schedule)

tuned.label: the PCL-002 declarative tail-pacing configuration armed through the pacing seam (tight linear backoff, two-retry budget, failure-class-aware cooldowns with expiry re-entry, event-stream-else-polled progress at the declared interval, declared timeout contract) (synthetic-supply, synthetic-cost, synthetic-latency)
tuned.basis: the PCL-002 declarative configuration (src/modules/executions/domain/tail-pacing-configuration.ts — the typed, closed, versioned pacing DATA), consumed through the app-local projection pinned in-suite against the real plane
